name: Progress Software Corp.
summary:
Progress Software (PRGS) reported earnings of $1.69 per share on revenue of $246.01 million for the fiscal third quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.49 per share on revenue of $247.16 million. The Earnings Whisper number was $1.60 per share. The company beat expectations by 5.63% while revenue fell 1.52% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

The company said it expects fourth quarter non-GAAP earnings of $1.24 to $1.33 per share on revenue of $297.0 million to $305.0 million. The current consensus earnings estimate is $1.41 per share on revenue of $251.36 million for the quarter ending November 30, 2026.

Progress provides software that enables organizations to develop and deploy their mission-critical applications and experiences, as well as effectively manage their data platforms, cloud and IT infrastructure.
subject: Progress Software Beat Expectations, Provides Mixed Guidance

name: Micron Technology, Inc.
summary:
Micron Technology (MU) reported earnings of $33.42 per share on revenue of $54.23 billion for the fiscal fourth quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $31.41 per share on revenue of $50.86 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $34.14 per share. The company missed expectations by 2.11% while revenue grew 379.27% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects first quarter earnings of $37.15 to $39.15 per share on revenue of $60.0 billion to $63.0 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $34.83 per share on revenue of $56.6 billion for the quarter ending November 30, 2026.

“Micron delivered record fiscal 2026 results, and we expect an even stronger fiscal 2027,” said Sanjay Mehrotra, Chairman and CEO of Micron Technology. “AI is becoming Super Intelligence (SI), and memory enhances this intelligence and the competitiveness of our customers’ platforms. We are increasing our investments in technology, products and manufacturing to help drive SI forward with our customers, and our Strategic Customer Agreements provide added confidence in the durability of Micron’s financial performance.”

Micron Technology Inc is a manufacturer and marketer of DRAM, NAND Flash memory, CMOS image sensors and other semiconductor components. It has two segments, Memory and Imaging.
subject: Micron Technology Missed Expectations, Guides Above Estimates

name: Bassett Furniture Industries, Inc.
summary:
Bassett Furniture Industries (BSET) reported earnings of $0.24 per share on revenue of $82.84 million for the fiscal third quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.13 per share on revenue of $83.05 million. The company beat consensus estimates by 84.62% while revenue grew 3.41% on a year-over-year basis.

Bassett Furniture Industries Inc is a manufacturer, importer and retailer of mid-priced home furnishings. The Company' business segments are Wholesale, Retail, and Investments and Real Estate.
subject: Bassett Furniture Industries Beat Consensus Estimates

name: Conagra Brands, Inc.
summary:
Conagra Brands (CAG) reported earnings of $0.41 per share on revenue of $2.60 billion for the fiscal first quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.31 per share on revenue of $2.59 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.31 per share. The company beat expectations by 32.26% while revenue fell 1.39% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

The company said it continues to expect fiscal 2027 earnings of $1.40 to $1.50 per share on revenue of $10.94 billion to $11.17 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $1.45 per share on revenue of $10.84 billion for the year ending May 31, 2027.

John Brase, president and chief executive officer of Conagra Brands, commented, "We delivered a solid start to fiscal 2027 with top line results largely in line with expectations and profit ahead of expectations amid a challenging operating environment. Importantly, we are acting on our previously outlined priorities including restoring margins, increasing investment, reducing complexity, and rebalancing capital allocation, which are translating into measurable progress across the business. While there is more work to be done, we remain on track to deliver the year and are reaffirming our fiscal 2027 guidance."

ConAgra Foods Inc is a packaged foods company. It sells its products through grocery, convenience, mass merchandise, club, and drug stores.
subject: Conagra Brands Beat Expectations, Reaffirms

name: Jabil Inc.
summary:
Jabil (JBL) reported earnings of $4.40 per share on revenue of $10.62 billion for the fiscal fourth quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $4.07 per share on revenue of $9.61 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $4.10 per share. The company beat expectations by 7.32% while revenue grew 28.65% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects first quarter non-GAAP earnings of $3.80 to $4.20 per share on revenue of $10.6 billion to $11.4 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $3.66 per share on revenue of $9.9 billion for the quarter ending November 30, 2026. The company also said it expects fiscal 2027 non-GAAP earnings of approximately $17.55 per share on revenue of approximately $44.5 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $16.67 per share on revenue of $42.2 billion for the year ending August 31, 2027.

“We delivered a fourth quarter that exceeded our expectations, closing an exceptional fiscal 2026 in which we grew revenue 21%, expanded core operating margin 40 basis points and generated more than $1.5 billion in adjusted free cash flow,” said CEO Mike Dastoor. “Our teams supported significant growth in AI infrastructure, delivered strong performance across several other end markets and brought critical new capacity online. These results reflect the progress we’ve made in moving up the value chain, taking on more of our customers’ engineering and manufacturing complexity while maintaining an asset-light model. I’m proud of our teams and the stronger business we’re building together.”

Jabil Circuit Inc, together with its subsidiaries is a provider of electronic manufacturing services and solutions. It provides electronic design, production &product management services to companies in the aerospace, automotive, & among others.
subject: Jabil Beat Expectations, Guides Above Estimates

name: FactSet Research Systems Inc.
summary:
FactSet Research Systems (FDS) reported earnings of $4.52 per share on revenue of $634.70 million for the fiscal fourth quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $4.32 per share on revenue of $628.23 million. The Earnings Whisper number was $4.40 per share. The company beat expectations by 2.73% while revenue grew 6.33% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects fiscal 2027 non-GAAP earnings of $19.25 to $19.65 per share on revenue of $2.600 billion to $2.625 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $19.84 per share on revenue of $2.620 billion for the year ending August 31, 2027.

FactSet supercharges financial intelligence, offering enterprise data and information solutions that help our clients maximize their potential.
subject: FactSet Research Systems Beat Expectations, Guides Below Estimates
